title: Waivable and Non-Waivable Charges on the Home Purchase Agreement Statement
content:
**Statement rule.** On the Home Purchase Agreement buyer statement, a closing extension fee or a closing delay per diem is waived in full when the extension or delay was caused by a builder delay recorded on the agreement. A returned payment fee, plan change fee, lot transfer fee, contract amendment fee and mutual release fee are never waived. Each waiver points to the charge number it waives. A charge is waived at most once, and a charge already collected is not waived. Charges not waived are collected on the closing date, one collection entry per charge.

**Basis.** Whether a charge has already been waived or collected is read from the agreement ledger by the charge number: a waiver entry or a collection entry naming that charge number.

## Charge reference

| Charge on the statement | Waived when | Never waived |
|---|---|---|
| Closing extension fee | The extension was caused by a builder delay recorded on the agreement: waived in full | — |
| Closing delay per diem | The delay was caused by a builder delay recorded on the agreement: waived in full | — |
| Returned payment fee | — | Never waived |
| Plan change fee | — | Never waived |
| Lot transfer fee | — | Never waived |
| Contract amendment fee | — | Never waived |
| Mutual release fee | — | Never waived |

## One waiver per charge

| Ledger already shows for that charge number | May the charge be waived? |
|---|---|
| Neither a waiver nor a collection | It may be waived, where its waiver condition holds |
| A waiver | No: a charge is waived at most once |
| A collection | No: a collected charge is not waived |

*Hypothetical statement line.* A closing delay per diem printed as charge number CHG-HP-0000 (a placeholder) on an agreement where the delay is a builder delay recorded on the agreement is waived in full by one waiver naming CHG-HP-0000; a second waiver of the same charge number is not written. A plan change fee on the same statement stays owed and is collected on the closing date.
